    Brick labels of covers in the poset of functorially finite torsion classes #

    Theorem 5.1 (thm:wide, condition (brick-label) in Theorem A(I)) of the manuscript: over an arbitrary field, R is E-finite if and only if every brick B in mod R arises as the brick label Filt(B) = U ∩ T⊥ of a cover T ⋖ U in the poset f-tors R of functorially finite torsion classes (isEFinite_iff_brickLabels).
